title: VAT
requirement: totalWithVat: net * 1.21 rounded HALF_UP to 2 decimals.
task: Add a method `public BigDecimal totalWithVat(BigDecimal net)` to DiscountService. It returns the net amount plus 21% VAT, rounded to 2 decimals using HALF_UP.
rationale: Explicit functional requirement including the rounding rule.
